name: EMDA-2
summary: EMDA-2, also known as 2-ethoxy-4,5-methylenedioxyamphetamine, 6-ethoxy-MDA, or 6-ethoxy-MMDA-2, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and methylenedioxyamphetamine families. It is the analogue of MMDA-2 in which the 2-methoxy group has been replaced with a 2-ethoxy group. This has resulted in EMDA-2 being described as the "TWEETIO" analogue of MMDA-2.
